consumer_price_index.definition: The standard index of the price of a basket of goods and services bought by households. Its change over time is the headline inflation rate.
consumer_price_index.example: The consumer price index is the number the news report quotes.

cs_credibility.definition: The part of a person's standing that says their word about their own work can be trusted.
cs_credibility.example: A public correction took her credibility away, and it took months to get it back.

frustrated.definition: A smaller angry feeling that comes when something still will not work.
frustrated.example: I am frustrated with this puzzle.

touch_base.definition: To have a short conversation with someone about something.
touch_base.example: Can we touch base on Thursday for fifteen minutes?
